doc: What fires the FX, the lights and the camera kicks (core/render/README.md). `sim` cues are read render-side from the sim snapshot (features/city/view/city_fx_feed.gd: a projectile slot appears = shot, disappears = projectile_end, a person turns dead = death), so they need no event and change no sim state. `event` cues follow an F-04 Events signal by name. fx: fx.json kinds spawned at the cue (the angle is the shot heading; projectile_end throws back, death uses the body heading). shake: a camera.json shake id ("" = none). shake_near_m: only cues within this many metres of the camera focus kick it (0 = always). hitstop: a camera.json hitstop id ("" = none): the game holds still that many ticks (SimClock.hold, none under reduced motion, cooled down by hitstop_cooldown_ticks).

triggers.doc: a round leaves a gun: the paper star at the mouth and a spent casing
a round stops (a wall, a car, a body or its range): ink chips thrown back
a person dies: an ink splat under the body
Rivet takes a hit (Events.player_hit): sparks off the chassis and the hit shake
Rivet kills someone (Events.actor_killed with killer_id = Rivet's id): the kill hit-stop, no FX of its own (the death cue draws the splat)
